```{r load_library, include=FALSE}
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(here)
```
# Configuration

```{r setup}
# File's path (change if necessary)
file_path <- here("Spreadsheets", "Metiloma_CP_PlanilhaINCA.xlsx") # The order is Folder name + File name
selected_cols <- params$target_cols # Choose what column you want selected
chip_cols <- 6 # How many columns will your chip have?
chip_rows <- 8 # How many rows will your chip have?
n_chips <- 1 # How many chips will you need?
```
***
# Functions
All of the code's functions reside here.
```{r validate_function}
validate_col <- function(file, target_col) {
  if (!(target_col %in% colnames(file))) {
    stop(paste("!!!ERROR!!! The selected column", target_col, "not found"))
  }
col_type <- class(file[[target_col]])
if (any(col_type %in% c("character", "factor"))) {
  message(paste("-SUCCESS-", target_col, "is a valid categorical column"))
  return = TRUE
} else {
  warning(paste("!!!WARNING!!!", target_col, "is", col_type, "- expected character or factor"))
  return = FALSE
}
}
```

***
# Data Loading

```{r data_loading}
loaded_data <- read_excel(file_path)
```
***
## Calculations
```{r calculations}
spots_per_chip <- chip_rows * chip_cols
total_samples <- nrow(loaded_data)
num_of_chips_needed <- ceiling(total_samples / spots_per_chip)
empty_spots <- (num_of_chips_needed * spots_per_chip) - total_samples

# Uncomment these lines if you want these informations in your doc
# message(paste("Total amount of samples:", total_samples))
# message(paste("Spots per chip:", spots_per_chip))
message(paste("The randomization will consider", num_of_chips_needed,"chips"))

message(paste("!!!ATTENTION!!! Your last chip will have", empty_spots, "empty spots"))

```
***
# Data Wrangling

```{r data_wrangling}
if (validate_col(loaded_data, selected_col)) {
  print("Proceeding to randomization...")
}
```
